records.title: Fundamental Reasoning Paradigms Induce Out-of-Domain Generalization in Language Models
records.reason: The paper induces deduction/induction/abduction behavior through fine-tuning, model upscaling, and MoE upcycling and measures out-of-domain reasoning. It targets training-time capability/generalization, not inference efficiency; capacity expansion is not a serving reduction.

records.title: Failure Modes in Multi-Hop QA: The Weakest Link Effect and the Recognition Bottleneck
records.reason: The paper diagnoses weakest-link and recognition bottlenecks in multi-hop QA, with experiments across context positions, datasets, and model scales. It analyzes reasoning failure modes rather than proposing a compute-, KV-cache-, memory-, or latency-saving inference method.

records.title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning
records.reason: Vero builds a general visual reasoning model and evaluates reasoning capability; no direct LLM inference resource optimization appears in the abstract.

records.title: Train at Moving Edge: Online-Verified Prompt Selection for Efficient RL Training of Large Reasoning Model
records.reason: The paper explicitly targets efficient RL training via prompt selection; training-only efficiency is outside this screening scope.

records.title: Instance-Aware Visual Language Grounding for Consumer Robot Navigation
records.reason: The arXiv primary abstract describes instance-aware visual-language maps for consumer robot navigation and reports navigation accuracy, but the linked primary paper body could not be fetched: arXiv HTML returned 404 and the 10.9 MB PDF exceeded the reader limit; the IEEE DOI page was inaccessible. Because this candidate is linked and body review is required, do not clear it from the abstract alone.
